info.title: Carmen Cloud Authentication
info.description: Carmen Cloud auth API: exchanges an API key for a short-lived bearer access token accepted on the `/workspace/{workspaceId}/**` routes, and serves the public signing keys that verify those tokens.

get.description: The JSON Web Key Set verifying tokens issued by `POST /token`. Standard well-known placement relative to the token issuer, so any off-the-shelf JWT library can verify the tokens.

post.summary: Exchange an API key for a bearer access token
post.description: Authenticates the `x-api-key` header and answers a short-lived (60-minute) bearer access token carrying the key’s workspace and role, plus the `workspace_id` to call the workspace routes with. The API key remains the long-lived credential: request a new token here whenever the previous one expires (there are no refresh tokens). Issued tokens cannot be revoked — they stay valid until expiry even if the key is disabled.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: The Carmen Cloud API key to authenticate.

403.description: Missing or invalid API key (`invalid_client`), or a key whose role cannot use the bearer surface (`access_denied`).

kid.description: Key id — matches the `kid` header of minted tokens.

keys.description: The active signing key(s). Two entries appear briefly during key rotation.

error.description: OAuth-style error code: `invalid_client` (missing/unknown API key) or `access_denied` (the key cannot use the bearer surface).

access_token.description: The bearer access token (RS256 JWT). Present it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on the `/workspace/{workspaceId}/**` routes.

expires_in.description: Token lifetime in seconds (RFC 6749 §5.1); 3600 today. Tokens cannot be revoked once issued — request a new one after expiry.

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry as unix epoch seconds (equals the token’s `exp` claim) — a convenience for wall-clock renewal scheduling.

workspace_id.description: The workspace the API key belongs to — the `{workspaceId}` to use on the workspace routes; no separate discovery call needed.

role.description: The API key’s workspace role, e.g. `ADMIN`.

scope.description: The granted scope, `cc.workspace.<role>.<workspaceId>` — the same format Cloud-Console tokens carry.
